meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-06 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c4d: −4 vs previous recorded night (40) · level with 7-night avg (36)
en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Lights out 22:38, up at 07:46 — 8h 32m, the longest night in the window and 1h 37m over the 6h 55m average. The score still came in at 77, four under the previous recorded night, and the reason is composition rather than length: 50 minutes of deep against 342 light and 120 REM, with 36 minutes awake. REM was the strong part of the night at 23% of sleep, which Garmin rated excellent. Deep is the thin part, and it is not a one-off — the last four recorded nights ran 48, 48, 61 and 50 minutes, after 107 and 98 in the middle of the window. Length has recovered; depth has not followed it yet. The autonomics are steady rather than sharp: HRV 36, level with the seven-night average, RHR 55, also level, and average stress 22 — the calmest reading of the seven. That combination reads as an unstressed but not especially charged system, which is what a week of low-intensity swimming in the heat tends to produce. Readiness lands at 73, moderate. Worth noting the two highest RHR mornings of the window, 59 and 60, both fell on the untracked nights of Aug 4 and 5, and last night's 55 already walked that back. Two evenings are missing from the chart entirely: Mon 3 and Tue 4 have no record because the watch was off the wrist overnight — Body Battery recharged 9 and 3 points on those mornings against 43 to 59 on tracked nights, and no HRV was written either. That is a wear gap, not a sync problem; every other Garmin stream ran clean through this morning. The seven bars therefore run Tue 28 to Wed 5. Wear it tonight and the next two nights go back on the record.

hr.c3d: +2 vs prethodna zabilježena noć (53) · isto kao prosjek 7 noći (55)
hr.c4d: −4 vs prethodna zabilježena noć (40) · isto kao prosjek 7 noći (36)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Gašenje svjetla u 22:38, ustajanje u 07:46 — 8h 32m, najdulja noć u prozoru i 1h 37m iznad prosjeka od 6h 55m. Ocjena je ipak stala na 77, četiri niže od prethodne zabilježene noći, a razlog je sastav, ne trajanje: 50 minuta dubokog sna naspram 342 lakog i 120 REM-a, uz 36 minuta budnosti. REM je bio jaki dio noći s 23% sna, što je Garmin ocijenio odličnim. Duboki san je tanki dio, i to nije jednokratno — zadnje četiri zabilježene noći išle su 48, 48, 61 i 50 minuta, nakon 107 i 98 sredinom prozora. Trajanje se oporavilo; dubina još nije krenula za njim. Autonomika je stabilna, ali ne i oštra: HRV 36, isto kao prosjek sedam noći, RHR 55, također isto, a prosječni stres 22 — najmirnije očitanje od sedam. Ta kombinacija čita se kao sustav bez stresa, ali ni posebno napunjen, što je upravo ono što tjedan niskointenzivnog plivanja po vrućini obično proizvede. Spremnost je 73 — umjerena. Vrijedi primijetiti da su dva najviša RHR jutra u prozoru, 59 i 60, oba pala na nezabilježene noći 4. i 5. kolovoza, a sinoćnjih 55 to je već vratilo natrag. Dvije večeri potpuno nedostaju na grafu: pon 3. i uto 4. nemaju zapis jer sat noću nije bio na ruci — Body Battery se tih jutara napunio 9 i 3 boda naspram 43 do 59 na zabilježenim noćima, a ni HRV nije zapisan. To je rupa u nošenju, ne problem sa sinkronizacijom; svi ostali Garminovi tokovi radili su čisto do jutros. Sedam stupaca zato ide od Uto 28 do Sri 5. Stavi sat večeras i sljedeće dvije noći vraćaju se u zapis.
